facts.fact: The Anambra State ICT Agency launched NORA, an AI-powered assistant that answers residents' enquiries about government programmes and services and tracks complaints, in Awka, as reported on 13 November 2026.

NGA.note: NORA serves general government information and complaints, not one sector's system.

facts.fact: The Anambra State ICT Agency says NORA was developed internally on adapted open-source technology, customised to the state's needs, at no financial cost to the state, and it was demonstrated live at launch.
The Anambra State ICT Agency says it developed the NORA AI assistant internally.
The Anambra State ICT Agency launched NORA, which it says was developed internally, in Awka, as reported on 13 November 2026.
